title: Original cannon and chariot siege cues
authorship: Original additive synthesis authored for YUGA; no recordings, sampled instruments, borrowed tune or commercial-game audio.
dependencies: Python standard library only: math, wave, struct, hashlib and JSON; no external packages.

synthesis.brass: Sum of harmonics 1,2,3,4 at weights 0.62,0.22,0.10,0.05; phase=2*pi*(f0*t+0.5*slope*t^2).
synthesis.wood: Damped sine modes at ratios 1,2.37,3.91, weighted 1,0.30,0.12; exponential decay rates 28,45,65 s^-1.
synthesis.drum: Damped modes 1,1.59,2.13; integrated exponential frequency fall with 0.024 s time constant; no physical-instrument fidelity claim.
synthesis.noise: Explicit Xorshift32 seeded per cue, normalized to [-1,1], one-pole smoothing coefficient 0.32; only short impact transients.
synthesis.envelope: Raised-cosine attack/release, final sample explicitly zero; normalized to each declared peak before PCM16 rounding.
synthesis.culture: Warm brass/wood-drum-inspired game cues, not an authentic raga/tala performance or historical instrument reconstruction.

mix_budget.assumptions: Six siege voices maximum, volume <=1, each player gain and positional max gain <=-12 dB. Existing traversal subsystem separately bounded at <=0.561. No other audio, effect gain or bus amplification included; runtime integration must enforce these conditions.

references.scope: Existing project synthesis/mix conventions reviewed; no waveform or melody copied.

limitations: Byte, PCM level, endpoint and distinction checks only. No human listening, perception, historical authenticity or physiological-benefit approval. Distinct hashes do not establish perceptual discrimination.

assets.description: Rising low brass-like harmonic swell; three quiet wood pulses.
Falling membrane-like strike, filtered air transient, low metal tail.
Three paired wood-like strokes under a restrained rising horn.
Lower drum-like strike with a brief offset wood knock and harmonic ring.
